records.check_results: Operative text matches all eight IDW draft descriptions: narrowed subject catalogue; up to two-year evidenced family-period extension; BWL one paper; four-hour non-tax papers; oral waiver at 4.00 in non-core modules; supplementary route deleted with transition; conditional future sustainability paper/oral changes; institutional equivalence confirmation eight years. records.title: Current examination regulation baseline

records.read_extent: Re-read header and complete sections 4–7, 13–19, selected physical pp. 4–10.

records.title: WPO statutory boundary for university exam credit
records.identity_version: Official consolidation; last amendment 4 February 2026; exact bytes match prior checked primary WPO.
records.read_extent: Re-read header and complete sections 8a, 13b and 14, selected physical pp. 10 and 12–13.
records.check_results: Section 13b limits this credit route to examinations in higher education, establishes equivalence in content/form/extent, and delegates procedure. records.limits: No claim that vocational entry is universally impossible: other entry routes remain. No full 77-page law read claimed.

records.title: BayObLG order 8 August 2025, 101 W 116/24
records.identity_version: Official Bavarian judiciary full-text publication of the 8 August 2025 order.
records.read_extent: Header and complete paragraphs 32–39, especially 36–38; not whole judgment.
records.check_results: The court regards IDW professional valuation pronouncements as recognised and commonly used despite methodological criticism. It separately says they lack binding legal-norm character. This is independent direct evidence of ordinary practical use, supplementing the examination catalogue and statutory professional framework.
records.limits: Decision concerns business valuation and judicial estimation, not a census of all audit assignments or a mandate to consult every pronouncement. Those universal propositions are not what IDW p. 6 says.

records.title: EFRAG IG 1 materiality-assessment implementation guidance
records.identity_version: Final May 2024, 55 physical pages, official EFRAG direct file. Older Assets/Download endpoint returned 404 through shell; web tool could extract it.
records.read_extent: Independently read disclaimer p. 2 and section 2.1 pp. 10–14, paragraphs 33–39; p. 14 boxed text visually inspected from actual direct-file render. No full 55-page read claimed.
records.check_results: Paragraph 35 calls impact/financial materiality often intertwined. Paragraph 37 says most material impacts may develop financial risks/opportunities over time; the p. 14 box states most material matters give rise to financial risks/opportunities. Examples explain delayed production losses, compensation claims and staff-turnover effects. This supports the ordinary qualitative relationship in IDW sustainability-reporting context, beyond merely hypothetical possibility.
records.limits: Non-authoritative ESRS guidance for large CSRD reporting entities, not an empirical population estimate, universal effect of every nonfinancial event or guarantee of recognised financial-statement loss. Ordinary unquantified often is retained; no percentage inferred.
records.short_excerpt: Impact materiality and financial materiality are often intertwined
